name: e1_core
question: Which parts of v4's core help? From the plainest loop (mutate the best program) upward: a population, a planner, notes for the planner; and is the mutation loop needed next to the planner? (Cut from 40 to 25 rounds on Nov 5: the plainest loop reached the known optimum by round 11, so later rounds tell nothing.)

notes.floor: the model sees the best program and writes a better one, 6 times a round
notes.population: v4's mutation loop alone: parents sampled by rank, another strong program for ideas
notes.plan+notes: v4's two loops with plain notes of every experiment for the planner
notes.planned-only: the planner with notes, no mutation loop
